title: 1RB0LC_1RC1RA_1RD0RF_0LE---_1LA1LE_0RA1LD: the return after a 00 pulse, in three modes (Lean)
text: 21 kernel-only rules for the head's return over the images after a 00 pulse: mode C restores words, mode E merges a stretch of 01 words into one run of 1s (a new fuse) and switches to A at a 011 word, mode A turns 01 words into runs of two. Mode A at a 011 word starts a new excursion, still open.
